f53: Tanks are indomitable bulwarks that absorb and deflect damage, taking hits so that the rest of the party stays safe. They are the vanguard of any group, using shields, heavy armor, monstrous transform effects, and sometimes even raw agility to block, dodge, parry, and shrug off incoming effects. With high health and defensive abilities, Tanks hold foes’ attention while the rest of the party does their job.

Healers are powerful spellcasters that wield their magic to bolster and rejuvenate allies. Able to buff, restore, and even resurrect fallen friends, most Healers are students of either the Holy Light or the eternal cycle of Nature. Some healers even weave these elements into more offensive schools, wielding holy cauterizing fire or soothing allies with frozen heals. With large pools of magic and an array of supportive spells, they are the backbone of their party, ensuring everyone can charge forward into danger.

Barbaric fighters, agile assassins, and powerful wizards all share a common goal: swiftly disposing of their enemies. Whether through a mighty storm of steel or a torrent or arcane magic, those who focus on slaying foes are known as Damage Dealers (DPS). This role encompasses the widest variety of Heroes: from wandering knights to rangers, thieves, and sorcerers. To walk this path is to embrace destruction.
